summary: The admitted v40 shop-floor case reaches dig.c:dig -> shk.c:shopdig(0) when the hero starts digging down inside a shop with a live keeper. C sets the keeper voice and prints “Madam, do not damage the floor here!”; JavaScript records shk.c:shopdig as unported and omits the warning. The canonical source scope is shk.c:shopdig plus its existing dig.c:dig, dig.c:digactualhole, and trap.c:fall_through call sites. The caller’s following shk.c:add_damage gap is a separate void helper and remains outside this diagnosis.

source.branch: shopdig first returns if shop_keeper(*u.ushops) finds no keeper, or if the keeper is not inside the shop (with the Knight alignment branch). It computes the keeper language from helplessness, silence, and msound. With fall == 0, a speaking, non-Deaf hero hears the keeper warning when muteshk is false; TT_PIT selects the careful-floor warning, otherwise the floor-damage warning. With fall != 0, a nearby nonhelpless keeper with an active bill or debit attempts to move next to the hero and take eligible inventory, while preserving worn, wielded, leashed, and current-wand exclusions.
callers: dig.c:dig calls shopdig(0) at line 1350 when the hero starts downward digging in a shop; js/dig.js:dig currently records note_unported("shk.c shopdig") at line 1147.
dig.c:digactualhole calls shopdig(1) at line 782 when a hero-caused hole falls through a shop; js/dig.js:digactualhole currently records note_unported("shk.c shopdig") at line 1464.
trap.c:fall_through calls shopdig(1) at line 668 when the hero falls through a hole or trapdoor while in a shop; js/trap.js:fall_through currently records note_unported("shk.c shopdig") at line 718.
dependencies: shop_keeper(), inhishop(), muteshk(), and rile_shk() are implemented in js/shk.js; the source shopdig branches consume their returned keeper or Boolean state.
m_next2u() is implemented in js/mhitu.js; shopdig consumes its Boolean result before and after the discarded mnexto() relocation call.
verbalize(), set_voice(), adjalign(), inventory operations, and shop billing helpers already have JavaScript implementations; shopdig must preserve their source order.
dig.c:dig calls shk.c:add_damage after shopdig(0), but that is a separate void helper and its existing note_unported remains outside this source diagnosis.
